current.text: Trae Young starts at point guard ahead of him. He is not in the projected starting five of Young, Kyshawn George, AJ Dybantsa, Anthony Davis and Alex Sarr.
He should not be handling point guard duties this season.
Washington added Trae Young, Anthony Davis and AJ Dybantsa.
Young, Davis and Dybantsa will take much of the usage, which cuts into the roles of the young players.
Washington has a crowded group of guards and wings, and the fifth starter spot is open with many wings competing.
Washington is expected to use a 10 or 11 man rotation, with 12 or 13 players who could justify minutes.
Washington is trying to compete for the play-in, so late-season rest and minutes cuts should not be a problem.
He is not a draft target in our 12-team auction.
